declarations.reason: Executive Board Audit v4 finding (Pages over-publication). deploy-pages.yml copied the whole repository (rsync of ./) into the Pages artifact, so CLAUDE.md, CHATGPT.md, package.json, scripts/, docs/, supabase/, workers/, model/ and memory/ were served publicly (live baseline 2026-10-09: HTTP 200). deploy-pages.yml is matched by this surface only because it lives under .github/workflows; it sends no e-mail and has no cron.
declarations.expected_behavior_change: The Pages artifact is built from an explicit ALLOWLIST: root pages, styles.css, sitemap.xml, CNAME, assets/, financial-crimes/, small-business/, the static Bolao frontend (transitional, tooling/docs/sql/py excluded) and bolao-teste redirect. Internal paths now return 404. A fail-closed guard aborts the deploy if an internal path appears in the artifact. No schedule, trigger, permission or e-mail behavior changes.
